$about: The align-engine manifest (ADR-005). The align/update/self-verify skills read THIS to know what an aligned repo must have at a given version - instead of hardcoding it in prose or JS. Paths are the assembled/client layout (an aligned repo), not this source repo's concern folders. An aligned repo carries a copy of this file at its pinned version; `scripts/self-verify.mjs` checks the repo against it and reports drift as a number.

adaptRules.copy: ship verbatim; the repo gets a byte-for-byte copy (guards, templates that carry no repo-specific content)
adaptRules.merge: combine the standard's content with what the repo already has, keeping both (ignore files, CI that already has jobs)
adaptRules.fill-from-repo: scaffold the shell from the standard, then author the body from THIS repo's reality - never blind-copy the example prose (ARCHITECTURE, PRODUCT, specs)
adaptRules.reference: do not copy; link to the standard at the pinned version (ADR-004 - the standard's own decisions reach clients by reference)
